name: Nijo Hidemi
source:
Seiran Academy, Second year

Good looking, intelligent and from a well-to-do family. He's been with Shuntaro in the same class since childhood.

He's the son of wealthy parents, He's good at sports and an excellent student. Seemingly perfect, he's a little aloof but is sometimes warm with Shuntaro.

From next spring he'll be an exchange student in America.

[From [url=http://www.joinac.com/GAS/graduation/English/chara/index.html]official site[/url]]
